anchors.description: Straight 3D distance between the two turned wooden corner-post finials at the foot end of the bed, i.e. across the bed's width (the footboard spans between them).
anchors.visible_evidence: Both brown wooden posts with ball finials are fully visible flanking the ornate metal footboard; the green test line lies across the foot end of the mattress and its two pillows sit side by side within that span, so a single double/full-or-queen bed is being measured.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Cannot distinguish full/double (54 in mattress, frame about 1.42-1.47 m) from queen (60 in, frame about 1.57-1.63 m); post centres are a few cm inboard of the frame outer edges. Interval spans both.

anchors.description: Long dimension of the right-hand plaid bed pillow, from its left seam corner to its right seam corner along the bed-width direction.
anchors.visible_evidence: Right plaid pillow leans against the metal headboard with its long side facing the camera; both end seams are visible. The two pillows together span about the mattress width, which excludes king-size pillows.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: US standard pillow (26 in approx. 0.66 m) vs queen pillow (30 in approx. 0.76 m); soft seams and the leaning pose can shift the apparent endpoints by a few cm.
